title: Radio: CCSO — Van License Plate Confirmed — Birch Hollow Range

lines.text: Sec, this is CCSO. We have the van’s license plate (HUOG-915-7X). The vehicle was seen on a local traffic camera near Route 14 at 09:11. It is en route to the hangar complex. The driver is in custody. We are forwarding the vehicle’s log and laptop drive to the managed SOC for forensic imaging. The van was not registered to any Group vendor.
CCSO, Sec confirms. We are not attempting to track the vehicle further. The Group will hold for handover. Acknowledged.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slight static

instructorNote: This is a distraction inject. The team now knows the attacker’s vehicle was in the area at 09:11 and is in CCSO custody. The vehicle's log and drive are being sent to managed SOC for forensic imaging. The attacker’s location and timing are confirmed, but the team must not divert from the core incident response.
